messages.raw: §fI gotcha ya a good story piling up, but beware!
messages.text: I gotcha ya a good story piling up, but beware!
messages.zh: 我给你攒了个好故事,不过可得当心!

messages.raw: §fbut her parents, oh no!, they were quite the brute
messages.text: but her parents, oh no!, they were quite the brute
messages.zh: 可她的爹娘,哎哟不得了! 凶得很呐

messages.raw: §fso the lil' fellow went out and about into the wood,
messages.text: so the lil' fellow went out and about into the wood,
messages.zh: 于是那小家伙一路走啊走,走进了林子里,

messages.raw: §f"a bit of rest wouldn't hurt" she said very bold
messages.text: "a bit of rest wouldn't hurt" she said very bold
messages.zh: “歇一会儿也没什么大不了”,她说得挺硬气

messages.raw: §fhe tugged himself in and went right to sleep,
messages.text: he tugged himself in and went right to sleep,
messages.zh: 他把自己裹好,倒头就睡,
可他接下来看见的东西……
